title: At-Home Happy Ending
details:
Avery Lust is lounging at home when she gets a surprise visit from a masseur, Reese Rideout. Reese explains that Avery's friends are treating her to a massage in the comfort of her own home, since it's her birthday. There is a hint of attraction between Avery and Reese.

After Reese has set up a massage table in Avery's living room, Avery admires him from afar. She then disrobes and lies down on the table, with more hints of mutual attraction between them. Reese gives Avery a sensual massage, as the sexual tension increases.

Knowing that they are both feeling the sexual tension, Avery playfully makes her move and asks if a happy ending is included in the massage too. Reese is very receptive, insisting that, for HER, it is!
